text: Donald Corbiere, Indigenous Affairs Consultant, Indigenous Affairs Office, and Narina Nagra, Equity and Diversity Consultant, People and Equity, will give a presentation on the Data for Equity Strategy, including a discussion on the idea of creating a circle of First Nation, Inuit and Métis (FNIM) leaders and persons to support City of Toronto's Divisions in engagement, partnership, and collecting/use of FNIM/Two-Spirit data.
The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee received the item for information.
